answer: Make each agent post a refundable stake bonded to a scarce external resource, then release rewards only along a slow reputation horizon. A fresh sybil starts as a cold ember with no earning power: it must fund real collateral and survive weeks of attested work before trust warms. Because spinning up ten thousand identities means ten thousand bonds, the attacker cost scales like an ocean, not a puddle, and the fakes drown economically long before they ever pay off.
